TAIYO'S ENTRANCE
CEREMONY IS TODAY.
I'M EARLY. CAN'T BE
LATE ON DAY ONE!

IT FEELS GOOD TO BE
UP EARLY. OH,
THERE'S BATSU. WHY'S
HE IN SUCH A HURRY?

HEY, BATSU! WHAT'S
THE RUSH?

QUIT DAYDREAMING,
{NAME}!
HURRY OR WE'LL
BE LATE!

HUH?! BATSU, WHAT
ARE YOU SAYING?
WE'VE STILL GOT AN
HOUR!

WHAT?! WE'RE ALMOST
LATE! LOOK... HUH? I
MISREAD MY WATCH BY
AN HOUR...

YOU'RE HERE AWFULLY
EARLY FOR ONCE,
BATSU.

OH, MORNING,
KYOSUKE.

UGH. OF ALL PEOPLE,
HE HAD TO CATCH
ME...

HM? SOUNDS AMUSING.
WHAT HAPPENED?

WELL, KYOSUKE, BATSU
LOOKED AT HIS WATCH
AND...

HEH. MAKING US LAUGH
ALREADY, BATSU? AND
THE CEREMONY HASN'T
EVEN STARTED.

HAHA! WHO MAKES A
MISTAKE LIKE THAT
THESE DAYS?
...TCH.

I'M LATE, I'M LATE!
HEY, WHAT ARE YOU
ALL DOING HERE? COME
ON, HURRY!
...PFFT.

HAHAHA! HINATA, YOU
TOO?!

HEH HEH. THAT'S OUR
HINATA...

W-WHAT? WHY ARE YOU
LAUGHING? WE'RE
GOING TO BE LATE!
HAHAHAHA...

WELL, THAT WAS QUITE
A COMMOTION BEFORE
THE CEREMONY...

HEH, REALLY. MAKING
THE SAME MISTAKE...
YOU TWO GET ALONG SO
WELL.

STILL LAUGHING? I
WAS JUST IN A RUSH.
DON'T LUMP ME IN
WITH BATSU!

I'M JUST AS SHOCKED!
ANYWAY, THE SPEECH
IS SO LONG...

YEAH... IT'S BORING.
I WISH I COULD SNEAK
OUT...

BATSU, YOU SHOULDN'T
KEEP SAYING THINGS
LIKE THAT.

YOU THERE! QUIET!
THE ENTRANCE
CEREMONY IS STILL
GOING ON!

(OH, CLASS REP. SHE
REALLY IS
SERIOUS...)

APOLOGIZE
TEASE HER

SORRY, CLASS REP...
WE'LL BE QUIET...

...BUT HOW ARE YOU
CLASS REP ALREADY?
WE'VE ONLY JUST
STARTED SCHOOL.

...OH? I'M ALREADY
ON THE DISCIPLINARY
COMMITTEE, YOU KNOW.

...HUH? ISN'T THAT A
BIT ODD?

YOU THERE! BE QUIET!
HOW LONG DO YOU PLAN
TO KEEP CHATTING?!

(YIKES... NOW WE'RE
REALLY IN
TROUBLE...)
CLICK!

(HUH? I THOUGHT I
SAW A FLASH... MAYBE
IT WAS NOTHING?)

(LET'S TEASE HER...)
CLASS REP'S FIRED UP
ALREADY! RIGHT,
BATSU?

YEAH. BUT SHE'S
SCARY WHEN SHE'S
MAD. WATCH YOURSELF.
WHAT DID YOU SAY?!

YOU THERE! STILL
TALKING?! BE QUIET!

(YIKES... WE GOT
TOLD OFF. I FEEL BAD
FOR CLASS REP...)
CLICK!

(HUH? I THOUGHT I
SAW A FLASH... MAYBE
IT WAS NOTHING?)

GETTING TOLD OFF AT
THE ENTRANCE
CEREMONY... WHAT A
START.

(HUH? WHO'S THAT
WITH A CAMERA? SHE'S
TAKING LOTS OF
PICTURES.)

HEY. WHAT ARE YOU
DOING OVER THERE?

ME? TAKING PICTURES,
OBVIOUSLY! IT'S FOR
THE NEWSPAPER CLUB'S
ENTRANCE TEST...

OH, YOU'RE THE ONE
WHO GOT TOLD OFF! I
GOT A GREAT SHOT OF
YOU!

OH... SO THAT FLASH
WAS...

YEP, ME! I WANT TO
JOIN THE NEWSPAPER
CLUB, BUT THEY HAVE
AN ENTRANCE TEST.

THE TEST IS TO GET A
SCOOP AT THE
CEREMONY. THANKS FOR
THE GREAT PHOTO!

YOU'RE A FIRST-YEAR
TOO? WAIT... DIDN'T
YOU GO TO THE
CEREMONY?

HEH, NEVER MIND! I'M
RAN, A FUTURE
REPORTER. NICE TO
MEET YOU!

THE CEREMONY'S OVER
AT LAST. NOW I NEED
TO JOIN A CLUB.

THE ALL-SCHOOL CLUB
ORIENTATION IS IN
THE CLUB BUILDING.
WHERE IS THAT?
